name: DHRP-8: Multi-Universe Portfolio Benchmark
description: An 8-asset-class portfolio evaluation benchmark spanning developed markets, emerging markets, commodities, sectors, global multi-asset, factors, crypto, and bonds. Each universe contains 10 ETFs with daily prices and volume from 2012-04 to 2026-04, plus financial news headlines (2013-04 to 2026-04) and Fama-French / AQR factor data. Released with multi-seed (n=10) trained model checkpoints for 11 portfolio allocation methods including the novel DHRP architecture.
citeAs: @inproceedings{anon2026dhrp, title={DHRP: A Differentiable Hierarchical Risk Parity Architecture and Multi-Universe Portfolio Benchmark}, author={Anonymous}, booktitle={NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track}, year={2026}}
rai:dataCollection: ETF prices and volumes are obtained from Yahoo Finance v8 API (public). Financial news headlines are scraped from Reuters, Bloomberg public RSS, GDELT 2.0, and SEC filings. FinBERT embeddings (768-dim) are extracted using the ProsusAI/finbert HuggingFace model. Fama-French factors via Kenneth French's online data library; AQR commodity Value/Momentum factors via AQR Capital Management's public research portal.
rai:dataBiases: Static ETF universes do not adjust for delisting or universe changes between 2012 and 2026, introducing a small survivorship bias. CPER (commodities) and several factor ETFs have inception dates after 2012 and are filled with NaN until inception. The Crypto universe history is shorter (2020-2026 only) due to limited ETF availability before 2020.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: All headlines are tagged with their primary ticker via either explicit metadata (Reuters/Bloomberg) or fuzzy matching against the universe ticker list. Headlines without a clear single-asset attribution are tagged as 'MARKET' and used as fallback when an asset has fewer than 2 headlines in a 90-day rolling window.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset contains only public market data and public news headlines. No individuals, no PII.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Initial release at NeurIPS 2026 camera-ready (December 2026). Yearly updates to extend the OOS window. Versioned via DOI on Zenodo with persistent identifiers.
